briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push multi-agent frontiers as US-China compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 major models this month with accelerating multi-agent capabilities. Global funding hit $14.9B in Q2 amid heightened export controls on advanced chips. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI o4 demonstrated 42% gains in long-horizon agent orchestration. Anthropic Claude 4 Opus and Google Gemini 3 Ultra launched with native tool-use expansions. xAI Grok-4 and DeepSeek-R2 closed capability gaps in reasoning benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New jailbreak techniques targeting production agents surfaced on arXiv. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced 200k H100-equivalent cluster expansions. TSMC began volume production of 2nm AI accelerators for US hyperscalers. Energy constraints are slowing new data center builds in Europe.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination breakthroughs trigger an earlier-than-expected intelligence explosion by 2028?
